title: Circadian Analysis of Inverted Feeding in Mice
author: Xin, Huang, et al.
materials: Eastep® Super Total RNA Extraction Kit

steps.title: Establish inverted feeding schedule
steps.instruction: Implement daytime‑restricted feeding (DRF) for experimental mice and nighttime‑restricted feeding (NRF) for control mice, maintaining the regimen for 36 days (or as short as 7 days) under regular light‑dark cycles.

steps.title: Allocate protocol time
steps.instruction: Reserve approximately 8 hours to complete RNA extraction, reverse transcription, and cDNA amplification.

steps.title: Homogenize tissues in cryogenic grinder
steps.instruction: Place 30–40 mg of kidney, heart, and left‑lobe liver tissue (or 80–100 mg adipose tissue) into the Cryogenic Grinding System (Shanghai Jingxin JXFSTPRP‑CL) and grind at 65 Hz for 2 min at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Keep all tubes, tips, and tools nuclease‑free.
Perform the grinding on ice or in a pre‑chilled 4 °C environment.

steps.title: Extract total RNA
steps.instruction: Transfer the homogenates to nuclease‑free tubes kept on ice and isolate RNA using the Eastep Super Total RNA Extraction Kit (Promega) according to the manufacturer’s protocol.

substeps.instruction: All steps are performed on ice or in a pre‑chilled 4 °C environment.

steps.title: Quantify RNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the extracted RNA with a spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Synthesize cDNA
steps.instruction: Aliquot 2,000 ng of total RNA into a reverse transcription reaction using GoScript Reverse Transcription Mix (Promega) and run the reaction following the kit instructions, keeping the reaction mixture on ice or in a pre‑chilled 4 °C environment.

substeps.instruction: Use nuclease‑free tubes and tips throughout the reaction setup.

steps.title: Amplify cDNA by qPCR
steps.instruction: Perform quantitative PCR using iTaq universal SYBR Green Supermix (Bio‑Rad) on a Bio‑Rad CFX96 Real‑Time PCR Detection System (Bio‑Rad) to analyze the cDNA.
